ctaHeading: Let's Build Your Dream Kitchen in Campbellfield.
aboutText: Borella Kitchens and Joinery, based in Campbellfield, has been crafting new kitchens and custom joinery for homes across Melbourne. We specialise in vanities, wall units, bars, and laundry cabinets for both new and existing homes. Our full service includes coordinating with plumbers, tilers, and electricians to ensure a seamless, worry-free experience for our clients.
servicesText: At Borella Kitchens, we offer comprehensive kitchen design and installation, along with custom joinery pieces to suit your space. Our services extend to coordinating with other trades, providing a complete package from start to finish in Campbellfield and surrounding areas.

services.title: Kitchen Design & Installation
services.desc: We create and install bespoke kitchens tailored to your lifestyle, using quality materials and expert craftsmanship.

services.title: Custom Vanities
services.desc: Our custom vanities are designed to maximise space and style in your bathroom or ensuite.

services.title: Wall Units & Storage Solutions

services.desc: Elevate your home with a custom-built bar, perfect for entertaining guests in style.

services.title: Laundry Cabinets & Joinery
services.desc: Functional and durable laundry cabinets designed to keep your laundry organised and efficient.

services.title: Trade Coordination & Project Management
services.desc: We manage all aspects of your project, coordinating with plumbers, tilers, and electricians for a hassle-free experience.
